body.name: R2
body.def: For active \(j=(C,s)\in J\), set \(U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}=N_{n2s}^{-1}\{\sum_l\mathbf 1[Y^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsl}<Y^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}]+\tfrac12\sum_l\mathbf 1[Y^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsl}=Y^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}]\}\), \(\bar U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{ns}=N_{n2s}^{-1}\sum_iU^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}\), and \(S^{2,U}_{n2s}=(N_{n2s}-1)^{-1}\sum_i(U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}-\bar U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{ns})^2\). When \(1\le m_{n2s}<N_{n2s}\) and \(S^{2,U}_{n2s}>0\), let \(D^R_{n2s}=m_{n2s}^{-1}\sum_iZ_{n2si}U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}-(N_{n2s}-m_{n2s})^{-1}\sum_i(1-Z_{n2si})U^{\mathrm{obs},2}_{nsi}\), \(\widehat v^R_{n2s}=S^{2,U}_{n2s}\{m_{n2s}^{-1}+(N_{n2s}-m_{n2s})^{-1}\}\), and \(R_{2j}=D^R_{n2s}/\sqrt{\widehat v^R_{n2s}}\); otherwise set \(R_{2j}=0\).
